# Sequel Census — the two-chapter story (GENERATED by backtest.sequel_census)

Terms: [docs/GLOSSARY.md](../../docs/GLOSSARY.md).

Engine `67d1f2dac` — OBSERVATIONAL, pre-registered (prereg_sequel_census, register 71; the narrative doctrine's first phase-two instrument, register 69). ASYMMETRIC BY DESIGN: anchors are the exhaustion family (S0-H1, S0-H2); sequels within {5,15} bars — ABSORPTION (S0-H3 signature, narrow-loud bar, or TEST print), OPPOSING-EFFORT (continued wide-loud in the original move's direction), or NONE. First qualifying bar decides; absorption outranks opposing within a bar. Every anchor fire lands in exactly one class — denominators stay whole. Lifts read against CLASS-CONDITIONED bases (each class's own episode-begin rate over all bars; anchor-dir proxy for generic bars = close direction, stated). PURPOSE: does exhaustion need absorption to become reversal (H1's sight-without-harvest gap)? Mint-on-lift, front door. ° = n<20.
